title.narrative: Trimmu and Panjnad Barrages Improvement Project

description.narrative: 1. Trimmu and Panjnad Barrages Project (TPBP) will rehabilitate and upgrade the Trimmu and Panjnad barrages on the Chenab River, which supply irrigation water to 1.74 million ha through six main canals. The project will (i) rehabilitate and upgrade the two barrages, and (ii) build institutional capacity in flood risk management. Trimmu barrage is located downstream of the confluence of Jhelum and Chenab rivers. Its flood passing capacity (FPC) is reduced from originally 18,265 cubic meters per second (m3s-1) to 12,743 m3s-1. The project will enhance the FPC to 23,220 m3s-1. Panjnad barrage is located downstream of confluence point of Sutlej and Chenab rivers. The project will enhance the barrage's FPC originally, from 19,822 m3s-1 to 24,495 m3s-1.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 2. Rehabilitated and upgraded Panjnad barrage. Indicator: One primary school for girls is upgraded to a mid-level school (2014 baseline: 0) Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: The construction work completed at both schools. 100% payment released to Education Department. Procurement of missing facilities furniture, IT Lab equipment and sports material completed.
Data Source: PID quarterly reports

Output: 4. Capacities of the communities and PID improved Indicator: 4a. At least 300 community members (250 of them women) in Trimmu and Panjnad and at least 150 community members (50% women) in Islam increased their skills in a specific training subject (2014 baseline: 0) Achievement: 450 Progress/Status: All skills trainings regarding food processing, homebased business, drafting and pattern making, handicraft & marketing and flood risk management have been completed at Trimmu, Panjnad and Islam Barrage. Awareness training at Panjnad is remaining completed Data Source: PID quarterly reports

Output: 4. Capacities of the communities and PID improved Indicator: 4b. Construction of two-family recreational parks, one each in the vicinity of Trimmu and Islam barrages, with 30% of the commercial spaces allocated to women (2014 baseline: 0) Achievement: 2 Progress/Status: Trimmu Park has been handed over to Irrigation Department, on 25 January,2023. Park at Islam Barrage completed. Data Source: PID quarterly reports

Output: 4. Capacities of the communities and PID improved Indicator: 4d. At least 20 PMO staff with enhanced skills in IWRM and FRM placed in the relevant positions (2014 baseline: 0) Achievement: 27 Progress/Status: 12 assistant executive engineers trained at IHE Delft in first batch. Flood Risk management training is completed for 80 locals (including women) living in the adjoining areas of the barrages prone to floods. In second batch additional 15 irrigation staff joined Master's degree program in 2021. The course commenced in October 2021 and has been completed. Data Source: PID quarterly reports

Output: 3. Islam barrage rehabilitated and upgraded Indicator: 3d. One primary school for girls is upgraded to middle school (2019 baseline: 0) Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: MOU signed with Education department. Construction of 02 Class Rooms completed. Data Source: PID quarterly reports

Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: All the barrage gates are rehabilitated. Three additional depressed bays constructed. All gates are operational with zero leakage. Water losses reduced to zero. Data Source: • PID barrage operation data

Output: 1. Rehabilitated and upgraded Trimmu barrage Indicator: • Water losses through the gates reduced to zero by 2020 (2014 baseline 15.3 m3s-1). Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: All 51 gates of main barrage are replaced. All 10 gates of Trimmu-Sidhnai Link and 5 gates of Haveli Canal are replaced and operational. All barrage and canals gates are operational with zero leakage Data Source: • PID Barrage operation data

Output: 2. Rehabilitated and upgraded Panjnad barrage. Indicator: • Panjnad barrage flood capacity is increased to 24,495 m3s-1 by 2020 (2014 baseline 19,822 m3s-1). Achievement: 24495 Progress/Status: Additional bays 100% completed. Flood capacity increased to 24,495 m3/s Data Source: • PID barrage operation data

Water losses through the gates are reduced to zero (2019 baseline: 2.8 m3/s to 8.4 m3/s) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Construction activities completed. DNP works under rectification and measurement. Water losses will be zero by Dec 2023 after rehabilitation of gates. Data Source: PID barrage operation data

Output: 3. Islam barrage rehabilitated and upgraded Indicator: 3a. Islam barrage capacity for water supply to the Qaim and Upper Bahawal canal systems is maintained at 35.5 m3/s (2019 baseline: 35.5 m3/s) Achievement: 35.5 Progress/Status: Contract awarded. Civil works commencement issued on 1 July 2021. Construction activities completed. DNP works under rectification and measurement. Capacity for water supply to the Qaim and Upper Bahawal canal systems will be maintained at 35.5 m3/s during execution of the project. Data Source: PID barrage operation data

Output: 2. Rehabilitated and upgraded Panjnad barrage. Indicator: • Panjnad barrage water supply capacity (to the associated canals) is maintained at 408.7 m3s-1 in 2020 (2014 baseline 408.7 m3s-1). Achievement: 408.7 Progress/Status: Work completed. Data Source: • PID quarterly reports

Output: 1. Rehabilitated and upgraded Trimmu barrage Indicator: • Trimmu Barrage water supply capacity (to the associated canals) is maintained at 577.14 m3s-1 in 2020 (2014 baseline 577.14 m3s-1). Achievement: 577.14 Progress/Status: Work has been completed on Trimmu. Data Source: • PID Barrage operation data

Output: 3. Islam barrage rehabilitated and upgraded Indicator: 3c. Islam barrage flood capacity is increased to 9,401 m3/s (2019 baseline: 7,560 m3/s) Achievement: 9401 Progress/Status: Work in progress. Current progress is 90.5% Vs 100% planned. Gates are under rehabilitation process. Flood capacity of barrage will be increased by Sep 2023. Data Source: PID quarterly reports

Output: 1. Rehabilitated and upgraded Trimmu barrage Indicator: • One women's basic health unit is upgraded by 2020 (2014 baseline' ‘no'). Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: Completed. 100% funds (8.13M) for purchase of equipment was transferred to Health Department after getting necessary approval from administrative department. All required equipment of regarding Gynae and Childcare was purchased by Health Department and handed over to BHU Rasheedpur.
Data Source: • PID's quarterly reports. Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: n Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: n Target year: 2020 Target value: y Actual value: 1

Revised guidelines for O&M approved and used by PID (2014 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: 2 Progress/Status: O&M Manual for Trimmu has been prepared. For Panjnad, this is being prepared and finalized. For Islam this are being prepared Data Source: PID quarterly reports Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2022 Target value: Y Actual value: 2

IWRM and FRM approaches officially approved and implemented in the business operations of PID's SPRU and PEA (2014 baseline: 0) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: This is being done under Technical Assistance 9255-PAK: Institutional Transformation of the Punjab Irrigation Department to a Water Resources Department. Data Source: PID quarterly reports; ADB technical assistance reports Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2022 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Taking over certificate has been released Data Source: • PAD's CRS

Panjnad barrage main irrigated area is maintained at 0.66 million ha (2014 baseline: 0.66 million ha) Achievement: 0.66 Progress/Status: Work has been completed and taking over certificate has been issued. All the gates of main barrage are rehabilitated. Additional bays progress is 100%. Data Source: • PAD's CRS

Trimmu barrage main irrigated area is maintained at 1.21 million ha (2014 baseline: 1.21 million ha) Achievement: 1.21 Progress/Status: Work has been completed on Trimmu. Taking over certificate has been issued on 1 January 2021. All 51 gates of main barrage are replaced. All 10 gates of Trimmu-Sidhnai Link and 5 gates of Haveli Canal are replaced and operational. All barrage and canals gates are operational with zero leakage. Additional bays completed.
